name: Chinchand Order Status Messenger for WooCommerce
author: chinchand

sections.description:
Chinchand Order Status Messenger sends automated WhatsApp messages when WooCommerce order statuses change (order placed, processing, completed). Connect your store to the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and map approved message templates to each order status.

Free features

  • Meta WhatsApp Cloud API settings with connection test
  • Enable/disable order status notifications
  • Order status notifications (placed, processing, completed)
  • Template name and body mapping for Meta-approved WhatsApp templates
  • In-plugin setup guide with links to Meta Developer Console

Pro version (sold separately on Freemius)

Upgrade to WhatsApp Automate Pro for:

  • Interactive COD confirm/cancel WhatsApp buttons
  • Indian courier tracking (ST Courier, Delhivery, Professional Couriers)
  • Meta webhook for inbound button replies
  • Abandoned cart recovery reminders

Pro is a separate plugin. Purchase on Freemius, then deactivate this plugin and activate Pro. The free and Pro plugins cannot run at the same time.

Get Pro on Freemius

External services

This plugin connects to third-party services to send WhatsApp notifications and optionally load a checkout for the separate Pro plugin.

Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (Facebook Graph API)

This plugin sends WhatsApp template messages through Meta’s WhatsApp Business Cloud API when a WooCommerce order status changes (for example: pending, processing, or completed).

Data sent may include the customer’s billing phone number, the Meta template name you configured, and template parameters derived from the order (such as customer name, order ID, order total, and shop name). The connection test in wp-admin also sends your Meta Phone Number ID and access token to Meta to verify credentials.

This service is provided by Meta Platforms, Inc.: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.

Freemius checkout (Upgrade tab only)

When an administrator opens WooCommerce → Order Status Messenger → Upgrade to Pro, the plugin may load JavaScript from Freemius to open an optional checkout for the separate Pro plugin. No customer/storefront data is sent until the administrator chooses to start checkout.

This service is provided by Freemius, Inc.: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin via Plugins → Add New → Upload, or install from the WordPress.org directory.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Order Status Messenger.
  4. Follow the setup guide to connect Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials.
  5. Map your approved Meta template names and body placeholders on the Notification Templates tab.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Meta developer account?

Yes. You need a Meta Business account, a WhatsApp Business app, and API credentials from Meta Developer Console. The plugin includes a step-by-step setup guide.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Open WooCommerce → Order Status Messenger → Upgrade to Pro, or purchase on Freemius.

Can I use this plugin and Pro together?

No. Only one plugin should be active. Pro includes everything in the free plugin plus premium features.

Does this work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required.
